_comment: package.json pins jquery to 2.2.4 and angular to 1.5.0, both of which Mozilla add-on policy bans (per assets/library-blocks.yaml). The banned-library check flags each as an error, and the OSV audit is skipped for them (banned -> no request). Their messages interpolate the version and the policy reason as well as the name, so the two findings never share a message and stay separate entries. Decided offline, no fetch. It also pins the EARLY EXIT's second reason id: banned-library names `disallowed-library-versions`, so the golden's closing block differs from the vulnerability fixtures' and the Standard Manual Review section is absent, its tally count 0.
